tool_input.command:
git filter-branch -f --env-filter '
if [ "$GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL" = "author@example.com" ]
then
    export GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="sam@example.com"
    export GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="Sam Okonkwo"
fi
if [ "$GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL" = "author@example.com" ]
then
    export GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="sam@example.com"
    export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="Sam Okonkwo"
fi
' -- --all
tool_input.description: Rewrite commits with personal email to use work email

tool_input.command:
git filter-branch -f --env-filter '
if [ "$GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL" = "harness@localhost" ]
then
    export GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="sam@example.com"
    export GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="Sam Okonkwo"
fi
if [ "$GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL" = "harness@localhost" ]
then
    export GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="sam@example.com"
    export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="Sam Okonkwo"
fi
' -- --all
tool_input.description: Rewrite commits with harness@localhost email to use work email

result: Done. All recent commits now have your work email (sam@example.com) as the author. The commit hashes changed due to the history rewrite, but the messages and content remain the same.
